item: Household tax-history record: repeated values
found: The internal tax-history record repeats some year-by-year values. Details are held internally and not published.
action: Check the repeated years against the county bills before relying on the history.

item: Property A assessed value for 2026 is a projection
found: The 2026 figure is a 2% projection of the prior assessment, not a bill.
action: Use the county roll for the 2026-27 year when it is published.

item: Property B effective tax rate looks high
found: The derived rate for Property B is higher than for Property A. Special assessments or bonds may be included.
action: Read the itemised bill for Property B.

item: Assessed value far below market for both properties
found: Under Prop 13 the legal base is not the market value. This is expected, but it means the model's base depends on the change-in-ownership rules.
action: Obtain a written valuation at date of death.

item: Market rent for Property A is not known
found: No official comparables were found. HUD Fair Market Rents are voucher benchmarks, not market rents.
action: Obtain at least three comparable rentals and a broker opinion.

item: FY 2027 Fair Market Rent values conflict
found: Secondary sites give conflicting values for the Bay Area counties. The Federal Register notice confirms the effective date (Oct 1, 2026) but was not used for values.
action: Left blank. Check the HUD query tool for the county and metro.

item: Measure H not yet certified
found: Measure H results are preliminary (74.42% yes). Certification is due within 30 days of Election Day (Dec 3, 2026).
action: Recheck after certification. Tier and pass-through rules are unverified.

item: SF documentary transfer tax tiers conflict
found: Secondary sources give different tier schedules. Measure I (transfer tax over $10,000,000) failed on the preliminary count, but it does not apply to sales at this price range.
action: Left blank in the model. Check the SF Treasurer page.

item: Insurance cost unverified
found: No official average premium was confirmed for either county. Secondary sites disagree widely.
action: Obtain quotes for both properties.

item: Solar credit depends on interconnection date
found: Under NEM 3.0 export credits are set by the net billing tariff. Installations before April 15, 2023 may have different terms.
action: Confirm the interconnection date and tariff with the utility.

item: Water provider for Property A not confirmed
found: The San Jose Water rate schedule is shown for reference only. Service to the address has not been confirmed.
action: Confirm the water provider and tariff with the bill.

item: Prop 19 repeal initiative: status reported, memo not opened
found: Secondary sources report that the initiative did not qualify. The Secretary of State memo was not opened in this session.
action: Recheck before any decision. This is a current-law point only.

item: Prop 19 loss after the heir moves out: two readings
found: The model keeps two readings (A: the Prop 19 base carries on; B: the base resets to value at transfer). The rule is not settled in the sources reviewed.
action: Counsel to confirm which reading applies.

item: California '1% tax above $1 million' is the Behavioral Health Services Tax
found: It is 1% of taxable income over $1,000,000 (Form 540, line 62; R&TC 17043). Large gains can reach it. The model applies a flat 13.3% state rate on gains.
action: CPA to confirm the state rate on large gains for the transfer year.

item: Public Git history contains a personal e-mail address
found: The base commit on main lists a personal e-mail address as the author. The repository is public. History was NOT rewritten.
action: Decide whether to rewrite history (requires a force-push to main and your explicit approval), or set the e-mail to private for future commits.

item: Parallel session branch overlaps this work
found: Branch arena/1277b9f1-tinodash4 has its own COORDINATION.md and claims the same files. It was not modified here.
action: Reconcile before any merge of that branch to main.

item: Platform branch rule differs from the request
found: The request asked for per-task branches and an integration branch. The platform allows one branch per session, so all work is on arena/8c530ff4-tinodash4.
action: No action beyond noting the constraint.

item: Household figures are used but not verified
found: Household figures are used in the model and held internally. Each is labelled USER and is not verified against an official source.
action: Verify against bills and appraisals before any decision.

item: Federal 2027 exclusion from secondary sources
found: The 2027 figures ($15,480,000 estate and gift exclusion; $20,000 annual gift exclusion) come from secondary reports.
action: Confirm on the IRS release before relying on them.

item: Repository privacy containment is partial
found: The Pages build now excludes alternate generated site trees and source directories, but those tracked files and prior public commits remain accessible through the public GitHub repository. This checkout cannot inspect or purge unavailable earlier history.
action: Treat this as partial containment only. A complete repository/history remediation needs an authorized administrator-led review; check forks, cached pages, PR diffs, and downloaded copies as well.
